units.source_text: 窗户依然张挂着夏天防虫的纱窗。

en.t: The window still had the summer insect screen hanging over it.

units.source_text: 还有一只飞蛾，好像贴在纱窗上，静静地一动也不动，伸出了它那像小羽毛似的黄褐色的触角。

en.t: There was also a moth, as if pasted to the screen, perfectly still, extending its yellow-brown antennae like tiny feathers.

units.source_text: 但翅膀是透明的淡绿色，有女人的手指一般长。

en.t: But its wings were a transparent pale green, about as long as a woman's finger.

units.source_text: 对面县界上连绵的群山，在夕晖晚照下，已经披上了秋色，这一点淡绿反而给人一种死的感觉。

en.t: Across the way, the ranges along the prefectural border had already taken on autumn colors in the evening light, so this small point of pale green instead gave an impression of death.

units.source_text: 只有前后翅膀重叠的部分是深绿色。

en.t: Only the part where the front and rear wings overlapped was a deep green.

units.source_text: 秋风吹来，它的翅膀就像薄纸一样轻轻地飘动。

en.t: When the autumn wind blew, its wings fluttered lightly like thin paper.
